verdict.rationale: Cua documents first-party programmatic surfaces for driving the product: an SDK in Python, TypeScript and Rust to create and drive computers from code, plus Cua Driver exposed through MCP or a CLI. These are documented interfaces, but no published HTTP API reference was found (all OpenAPI/Swagger paths return 404), and one hands-on report shows a Computer API Server WebSocket connection failure in an older release. missing for 10: a published HTTP/REST API reference or OpenAPI spec, in-depth API reference documentation beyond SDK overview lines, and independent corroboration that the programmatic API works reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
